description: This file defines the interface 'CalendarSyncConfigInterface' for managing calendar synchronization configuration in SuiteCRM. It specifies methods for retrieving and setting configuration parameters such as sync windows, conflict resolution strategies, deletion permissions, and last run timestamps.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of all configuration keys.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns an array of all configuration values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets configuration values based on the provided array.

methods.name: getMaxAccountsPerSync
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of calendar accounts processed per sync.

methods.name: getMaxOperationsPerAccount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of meeting operations per account per sync.

methods.name: getSyncWindowPastDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days looking into the past for synchronization.

methods.name: getSyncWindowFutureDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days looking into the future for synchronization.

methods.name: getConflictResolution
methods.description: Returns the conflict resolution strategy identifier.

methods.name: allowInternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if internal events can be deleted.

methods.name: allowExternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if external events can be deleted.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Indicates if calendar sync logic hooks should be executed.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Returns the external calendar name used for sync.

methods.name: getLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last manual sync run, or null if never run.

methods.name: setLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the last manual sync run.
